name: deepseek_alias_20261104
comment: ANCHOR: DEEPSEEK_ALIAS_20261104 — the legacy DeepSeek v4 ids are removed from both surfaces that could select a model id: the llm_lane routing set and the run-manual endpoint's lane map (LANE_TO_POLICY / FLASH_LANES). In llm_lane they are no longer accepted at all (`deepseek-v4` alone raises the typed ambiguous-lane error; the two full v4 names are simply unknown, not typed-error aliases); on the run-manual endpoint `deepseek-v4-flash` is refused as LANE_NOT_ALLOWED and `deepseek-v4-pro` as POLICY_NOT_ALLOWED. The invariant test checks the lane map against the registry and asserts those behavioural outcomes. Hermetic: imports only, no network, no provider call (the probe is stubbed).
